text:
If god, Love, what heaven? If lord, what estates? Where servants and seat?


If mortal veil disguises you, what retreats? If rich, where goods? Why naked in sun and ice?


Painting you winged and blindfolded means painter and world mock you.


So do I, since Lisis's honest face cowed you until you look like blindman's buff.

translation.title: If You Are a God, Love, What Is Your Heaven?...
